name: Smoke Copilot Routed
goal: Keep Copilot main routing within allowed models while maintaining independent unrouted threat-detection inference.
acceptance: Both protected gates establish main routing from actual proxy/session evidence and detection completion on its dedicated model, without routing/classification leakage.

gates.name: Assert model-routing evidence
gates.meaning: Allowed main-model routing and actual inference requests.

gates.name: Assert threat-detection evidence
gates.meaning: Dedicated-model detection completion, no routing/classification leakage.

limitations: Both source-defined main and detection conjunctions are required; no constituent outcomes are inferred from a failed gate.

historicalSourceProfiles.review: Source intent and native predicate steps are identical. Reviewed differences: read-only artifact export paths, Copilot CLI minimum-version configuration, and Pi model-alias/error-reporting integration. The session merger's added model.resolution events do not satisfy routing assertions. Historical runtime trees remain pinned as complete profiles, never mixed with current jobs.
